messages:
matt: Heads up — noticed EU p99 jumped ~420ms right after the regional failover last night. Dashboard shows sample_count for /v1/generate down to 6 for the 5m bucket. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/screens/abc123
ayana: ugh low sample counts + smoothing windows are a classic. Did the rollup fall back to bucketed mode?
oliver: We do tdigest rollups and if q_samples < 20 we switch to bucket-merge fallback. That plus the 60s decaying window can create stepy p99s.
sre-jen: @matt can you paste the raw numbers for that interval? I want to see the distribution not just the rollup pct.
matt: quick dump from the metric store:
```
window_start: 2026-03-22T03:10Z
endpoint: /v1/generate
region: eu-west-1
sample_count: 6
latencies_ms: [34, 48, 50, 120, 430, 450]
tdigest_p99: 450
raw_p99: 450
```
ayana: interesting — raw samples reflect the spike but with only 6 points p99 is noisy. The UI smoothing (exponential smoothing tuned to 0.2) amplified the step after the failover.
product-julia: For the console UX: when sample_count < 20 we should show an explicit badge "low samples — percentiles unstable" and a tooltip explaining tie-breaker behavior. Users keep assuming percentiles are stable.
oliver: +1 on badge. Also we can tweak the telemetry: surface both tdigest-derived p99 and raw-sample p99 when raw count <= 200. That gives context.
sre-jen: Also consider a deterministic tie-breaker when counts are tiny: e.g., treat p99 as the max(sample) for n<=10 and show it as "peak" to avoid misleading smoothing.
ayana: or show confidence interval: p99 ± bootstrap CI. But that'll cost compute. Maybe approximate CI using order-statistics for small n.
matt: quick repro command I ran against the ingest datastore:
```
# fetch samples for interval
curl -s 'https://telemetry/api/query?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate&region=eu-west-1&from=2026-03-22T03:00Z&to=2026-03-22T03:20Z' | jq .samples
```
It returns the list above.
product-julia: For rollout docs: add a note that failover can reduce samples for a period and cause percentile artifacts — recommend using median for SLOs on low-volume endpoints.
oliver: I'll open a small follow-up: (1) add low-sample badge + tooltip, (2) show raw-sample p99 when count<200, (3) switch smoothing window to ignore one-off region failovers for 2m if sample_count < 50.
devex-bot: action created: ENG-PLAT-1421 — "Low-sample percentile UX + telemetry" assigned to oliver, due 2026-03-29.
sre-jen: For monitoring/alerts: avoid triggering p99 SLO alerts if sample_count < 30 for the window. We'll gate alerts on sample_count.
ayana: Agree. Also add a console debug view that lets SREs toggle between tdigest rollup and raw sample aggregation for a selected bucket. That helped me debug similar issues before.
matt: thanks all — will note in the incident timeline that the p99 jump was an artifact of low samples + smoothing, not a systemic regression.
product-julia: I'll update the docs and changelog blurb once ENG-PLAT-1421 lands.
oliver: starting work tomorrow, will post a brief design in #eng-platform and ping when PR is up.
matt: :thumbsup:
